waveform_summary: Pointwise median and 25th–75th percentiles across 12 separate sample paths per group; 32 normalized progress points.
temporal_note: The two operation groups are interleaved across sample paths; later recovery follows the corresponding transfer path, not completion of the entire first group.
interpretation: Outcomes were already known. AUC is within-run post-hoc path-score separation, not held-out diagnostic sensitivity. Earliest qualifying is not necessarily the first abnormality or causal origin; no actual delivered-volume estimate or root-cause proof.
privacy: No run, instrument, sample, barcode, well, operation index or exact date/time identifiers and no individual traces are exported.
